_comment: Where each set's turf is drawn on the map, as rectangles.
WHY RECTANGLES. There is no native that draws a polygon on the map, so the only shapes
available are the disc (ADD_BLIP_FOR_RADIUS) and the box (ADD_BLIP_FOR_AREA). A box can
be rotated, so it can be laid along a street; a disc cannot be laid along anything, which
is why the first version of this looked like spilled paint.
A zone may have as many boxes as it needs. Two or three laid end to end will follow a
boundary that one box cannot -- that is how you get a hard line down a street rather than
a shape that approximately covers the area.
x, y      centre of the box, in world coordinates
w, h      how wide and how deep, in metres, BEFORE rotation
rot       degrees clockwise. 27 is roughly the South Los Santos street grid
EVERY NUMBER IN HERE IS A STARTING POINT AND IS MEANT TO BE CORRECTED. They are derived
from the zone centres and radii in zones.json, which are bounding circles rather than
shapes -- so they are the right ballpark and nothing more. Stand on a corner you want the
line to run along, read the coordinate off the screen, and put it in. No rebuild.
